text.tspan: Industry as a share of GDP vs. GDP per capita 2016
The vertical axis shows historical estimates of the share of industry in GDP. The horizontal axis shows GDP per
capita, adjusted for inflation and differences in living costs between countries.
GDP per capita (international-$ in 2011 prices; plotted on a logarithmic axis)
Share of manufacturing in GDP (% GDP)

tspan.tspan: Herrendorf et al. and Groningen Growth and Development Centre (2015); Bolt and van Zanden – Maddison Project Database
GDP per capita is expressed in international-$ at 2011 prices. Where data for 2016 is unavailable, the value from the closest year
